TaskEnvelope.description: Server-issued only. Never accept authority-bearing fields from model output. Child effective grant is the intersection of parent grant and role policy.

AgentHandoff.description: A proposal to the coordinator, not delegated authority. Server checks the allowed workflow edge, authorized references, shrinking grant, resource versions and deadline before issuing TaskEnvelope.

x-principal-contract: Signed server credentials include principal_kind human/agent, actor_id, delegation_ref, scopes and task binding. Agent credentials are independently scoped and cannot call human-only endpoints even when acting for a buyer. x-* constraints are mandatory implementation requirements, not controls supplied by an OpenAPI validator.
x-runtime-contract: AgentManifest defines six logical roles. Coordinator is deterministic. Tool schemas and outputs checked server-side; model profile migration cannot relax domain contracts.
